notes.source: Removed minimums citywide in 2023. The city's 2026 review found no verified negative effects; developments still provide off-street parking, and one Girdwood housing project used the freedom to build fewer spaces.

Removed minimums citywide in December 2023 (downtown and Canal Park already had none). The city sold two downtown ramps to a housing developer to serve tenants; new buildings with under 0.5 spaces per home must file a parking plan.

reference_line.info: Median of real cases, applied to Wisconsin: the median of the 76 repeal places changed by -0.12 permits per 1,000 existing homes per year against its comparison places. Applied to Wisconsin's 2,668,677 homes outside places that already removed minimums (fully or with conditions), that is about -311 permits a year, -1,557 over 2027–2031, slightly below the central case; shown without a floor at zero.
reference_line.label: Median of real cases

scenarios.info: Like the 76 US places that removed parking minimums: in the one to three years after, their permit rates did not rise measurably compared with similar places that kept them.
scenarios.label: No measurable change

scenarios.info: If the true average effect is at the top of what the evidence allows (95 times in 100, the real average would be lower): 1.47 more permits per 1,000 existing homes per year, everywhere except places that already have no parking minimums for housing (or removed them with conditions). Other versions of the high end from the improvement rounds ran about 27,700 to 49,700 homes, so this end is uncertain by about 2 times.
scenarios.label: High end of the evidence

scenarios.info: The measured average of the 76 repeal places against similar places: -1.15 permits per 1,000 existing homes per year. It is pulled down mostly by Austin, Minneapolis and San Francisco, whose permits fell after repeal more than similar places'; the typical repeal place changed by about 0. The data can't rule out a drop this size; it is shown without a floor at zero.
scenarios.label: Low end of the evidence
